    tri_indices = np.array(tri_indices)
    n_tri = len(tri_indices)

    def calc_areas(points):
        """
        Calculate areas of all triangles defined by tri_indices.
        points: (n, 2)
        returns: (n_tri,)

        p1 = points[tri_indices[:, 0]]
        p2 = points[tri_indices[:, 1]]
        p3 = points[tri_indices[:, 2]]

        v2 = p3 - p1
